text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What is it? I thought I heard someone 
calling for me—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The Three Goddesses... Umamusume who 
united the realm, eh? Could it be that you 
three are...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh, how intriguing! Are you saying 
you wish to witness my conquest of the 
realm?
